assertions.source: smooth real u(q0)∝log q0 gives ratio~1; measured is -4.08 -> phase channel

description: Sharpens the z(q₀) gap for the c₃ bar-ODD S via the Neumann–Zagier complex-volume deformation of 4₁. Computes Vol(4₁)=2Λ(π/3), notes CS(4₁)=0 (amphichiral ⇒ S is a deformation phase, not the knot's own CS), and shows a SMOOTH real-scaling deformation u(q₀) cannot produce the measured S(proton)/S(muon)=−4.08 (anchors differ at ~1e-8) — so u(q₀) is a phase-channel / root-of-unity-accumulation quantity, the open z→c_k evaluation map. Scope-(a); C14 anti-fitting; no c_k wired.

cs_4_1_complete.note: amphichiral ⇒ S is a deformation phase

smooth_deformation_ruled_out.conclusion: smooth real u(q0) gives ratio~1, not -4.08 -> phase channel / RoU accumulation
